title: Independently verify integrated auth journey and regression
objective: After serial integration and independent review approval, verify the exact combined candidate on fresh owned real PostgreSQL/provider/application and exported browser surfaces. Return PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED with precise limitations and defects; no production fixes.
allowed_scope: approved candidate, disposable fixture and redacted reports for verification only
acceptance_criteria: Actual min12/no mandatory mailbox signup and login, functional recovery hash/code exchange, MFA primary/backup, current/global logout and protected-domain gating verified
Strict provider terminal reuse and actual protected-app negatives retained on canonical migration/FKs/roles
Exported browser CSP/SRI/private gallery/audio, responsive widths, zoom, keyboard/focus/announcements, reduced motion and font-failure behavior verified
Native secure-storage fixtures distinguished from physical Android/iOS evidence
Existing profile/navigation/cache/callbot regressions and exact root/candidate identity verified
Missing native/hosted/organizational approvals explicitly BLOCKED or documented, never silently PASS
required_tests: Fresh disposable real provider+application end-to-end and authorization negatives
Combined regression and artifact/evidence rejection gates
Fixture ownership/isolation/cleanup and final root source comparison
